name: Lighteval
description: Hugging Face's evaluation toolkit, built by the team that ran the Open LLM Leaderboard. It supports 1000+ tasks across transformers, vLLM, SGLang, Nanotron and API endpoints, saves sample-level outputs for debugging, and since 2025 uses Inspect AI as its preferred execution backend. Scores are self-run by the user, with task configs (prompts, metrics, few-shot) versioned in the repo so numbers can be reproduced.
notes: First GitHub release v0.1.1 on 2024-02-09 (an internal 0.0.1 appeared on PyPI 2023-10). Benchmarks from src/lighteval/tasks/tasks: mmlu, mmlu_pro, gpqa (gpqa:diamond), hle, aime (aime25), gsm8k, math, hellaswag, bigbench_hard, ifeval, simpleqa, mmmu_pro, lcb (LiveCodeBench), drop_qa, winogrande, truthfulqa, arc_agi_2. README lists RULER but no ruler task file was found in the current tree, so it is omitted.
